changelog:
A paused film starts again when you press OK.

WHAT WAS FIXED

- Pausing worked, but the television did not notice it had paused, so
  the next press paused again instead of starting the film. It now
  notices, and OK pauses and starts the way you would expect.
- The paused indicator on the television works now, and the phone can
  see when the television is paused.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. Pairing, playback, updating and the user-agent fix
  from 0.1.3 are unchanged.
